tests.name: Signup
tests.assertion: A brand-new KSTEST user signs up through the real signup UI of the staging app; lands logged in; the session survives force-stop + relaunch

tests.name: Post page location fallback
tests.assertion: Logged in, /post step 3, "use my current location": GPS on → coordinates near the emulator position (which step: cached ≤ 10 min / fresh ≤ 20 s recorded); GPS off → within ~25 s the clear fallback message (on screen, not covered) with the village field in view, no crash
tests.notes: GPS on → cached (after one GPS reading in the page; a fresh LOW-accuracy fix was not available on this emulator); GPS off → fallback after 20435 ms
